cross_readers.source: https://github.com/DomCR/ACadSharp at d7dc111023477d8a9fffc2153139459c95b4f345 (upstream 3.7.1, built from source, JIT, DwgReader.Read), via tools/r0-open/acadsharp-dump. This is the C# source acadsharp-rs wraps, without libviprs-dep's NativeAOT build and patches.

determinism: tools/r0-open/rust/run-write.sh writes every probe twice and compares the two DWGs byte for byte; 26 of 26 were identical on the run that produced this revision (a statement about the acadrust writer only, not about any vendor writer)
evaluator: none (no STEP evaluator ran; there is no STEP output)
evidence_statement: KNOWN_TRUTH_EXACT here means one thing: the DWG bytes, decoded by two independent open readers, carry the authored mathematics, exactly where the DWG stores it verbatim and within PVec numeric policy v1 where it stores a derived value. There is no STEP oracle: no STEP file was produced, read or compared, and nothing here says how any converter treats these drawings.

fixtures.capabilities_note: layer state (off, frozen) is source visibility information whose use is libviprs policy (N1.4); the PVec 2D semantic profile has no capability for it

fixtures.downstream_disposition: NEAR_SINGULAR_TRANSFORM (QUARANTINE): the DWG carries this transform as authored, so reader mapping is checked, but a mapper must not emit a curve for this entity

own_readers.source: https://github.com/libviprs/acadrust at d35691f483534e4affc3a4065486e168c898ac7d (0.5.5 plus 132 commits), DwgWriter and DwgReader, via tools/r0-open/rust

reader_independence: The two readers are independent in code, not in specification: both implement the same DWG specification, so a cross-read catches round-trip loss and decoder bugs that differ between them, but not a shared misreading of the specification itself.
self_contained: this directory holds every DWG, every read record and a hash-pinned copy of each authored record and parameter file; nothing outside it is needed to run `check`
writer_source: https://github.com/libviprs/acadrust at d35691f483534e4affc3a4065486e168c898ac7d (0.5.5 plus 132 commits), DwgWriter and DwgReader, via tools/r0-open/rust
